clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Syurna trains night elf rogues in the Cenarion Enclave. She guides aspiring scouts, spies, and covert operatives, then sends new rogues on trials of stealth and cunning.

Syurna trains those who move unseen through Darnassus. In the Cenarion Enclave, she teaches rogues evasion, lockpicking, and lethal strikes. The Sentinels display the Kaldorei’s martial strength, while the Sisterhood of Elune holds its spiritual wisdom. The Kaldorei also depend on shadows and stealth, and Syurna sharpens the eyes and blades that guard Teldrassil.

Syurna tests young operatives beyond the lessons taught in the enclave. She sends promising initiates into deeper fieldwork to see whether they have the instincts to survive beyond the World Tree’s boughs and serve the Alliance in perilous frontier lands.
